overview: The Medford City Council commended retiring Fire Chief Frank Giliberti, addressed severe road paving delays associated with Eversource utility work, and approved several ceremonial resolutions.

items.title: Commendation of Retiring Fire Chief Frank Giliberti
items.summary: The council approved a resolution congratulating Fire Chief Frank Giliberti on his upcoming retirement after 39 years of service and welcoming incoming Chief John Friedman.

items.title: Eversource Street Paving and Utility Work Delays
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting an update on overdue street paving on South and Prescott Streets and calling a Committee of the Whole meeting with Eversource representatives.

items.title: Resolution in Memory of Robert Amari
items.summary: The council dedicated the meeting and held a moment of silence in memory of lifelong resident and Korean War veteran Robert Amari.

items.title: 60th Wedding Anniversary Recognition
items.summary: The council approved a resolution congratulating Ralph and Loretta Evangelista on their 60th wedding anniversary.

items.title: Veterans Day Recognition
items.summary: The council passed a resolution observing Veterans Day with a moment of silence to honor local veterans.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Reports
items.summary: The council accepted committee reports regarding traffic safety matters in the North Harding area and at Brooks and Irving Streets.

items.title: Election Congratulations
items.summary: Council President Caraviello commended candidates and congratulated re-elected and newly elected members following the recent municipal election.
